[Company Overview] Genkit AI Overview & Mission: Genkit AI is a leading enterprise neural intelligence platform powering next-generation conversational agents and automated business solutions. Our custom Transformer architectures combine self-attention neural models with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to deliver fast, highly accurate, and domain-grounded responses tailored for enterprise workflows.

[Services Offered] Core AI & Machine Learning Services: Genkit AI provides specialized AI development services including: 1) Custom LLM & Transformer Fine-Tuning, 2) Enterprise RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Vector Engine Setup, 3) Autonomous AI Agent Workflows, 4) Custom Subword Tokenizer & Model Compression, and 5) Intelligent Search & Knowledge Base Indexing.

[Services Offered] Full-Stack Web & Software Development: In addition to AI solutions, Genkit AI offers full-stack web and cloud application development. We build modern, high-performance web apps using React, Vite, Next.js, Python FastAPI, and Node.js.

[Services Offered] Full-Stack Web & Software Development: In addition to AI solutions, Genkit AI offers full-stack web and cloud application development. We build modern, high-performance web apps using React, Vite, Next.js, Python FastAPI, and Node.js. Our team designs scalable cloud backend microservices, real-time streaming APIs (SSE & WebSockets), and containerized Docker/Kubernetes deployments.

[Technology Architecture] RAG Architecture & Document Indexing Pipeline: Our proprietary RAG engine processes PDF, DOCX, and TXT files into overlapping semantic text chunks (300 characters with 50-character overlap). Dense vector embeddings are generated and stored in a vector database.

[Technology Architecture] RAG Architecture & Document Indexing Pipeline: Our proprietary RAG engine processes PDF, DOCX, and TXT files into overlapping semantic text chunks (300 characters with 50-character overlap). Dense vector embeddings are generated and stored in a vector database. When a user asks a query, cosine similarity vector search retrieves the top matching context chunks, which are fed into the prompt builder to produce accurate, context-grounded AI responses.

[Security & Privacy] Security, Compliance & User Data Isolation: Security is built into every layer of Genkit AI. We utilize JWT (JSON Web Tokens) with 60-minute expiration for session authentication, combined with bcrypt salt password hashing.

User chat sessions and uploaded knowledge base documents are strictly isolated per user/organization.

[Security & Privacy] Security, Compliance & User Data Isolation: Security is built into every layer of Genkit AI. We utilize JWT (JSON Web Tokens) with 60-minute expiration for session authentication, combined with bcrypt salt password hashing. User chat sessions and uploaded knowledge base documents are strictly isolated per user/organization. All data transmission is encrypted using HTTPS and TLS 1.3.

[AI Development] Model Training & Custom Architecture Specifications: The underlying PyTorch model features 4 encoder layers, 4 decoder layers, 8 multi-head attention mechanisms, and a 256 d_model dimension size.

[AI Development] Model Training & Custom Architecture Specifications: The underlying PyTorch model features 4 encoder layers, 4 decoder layers, 8 multi-head attention mechanisms, and a 256 d_model dimension size. It uses custom subword tokenization trained on domain-specific corpora to optimize inference speed and token efficiency for low-latency edge and cloud deployment.

[Product Features] Supported File Formats & Document Upload: Genkit AI supports automated document parsing for PDF files (.pdf), Word documents (.docx), plain text files (.txt), and direct web page scraping.

[Product Features] Supported File Formats & Document Upload: Genkit AI supports automated document parsing for PDF files (.pdf), Word documents (.docx), plain text files (.txt), and direct web page scraping. Uploaded documents are automatically parsed, chunked, embedded, and indexed into the active RAG vector database instantly via the Admin Dashboard.

[Case Studies] Industry Solutions & Use Cases: Genkit AI powers AI transformation across diverse industries: Healthcare (patient query routing & medical PDF search), E-Commerce & Retail (24/7 customer support & product recommendations), Legal & Finance (contract analysis & regulatory compliance search), and Tech Enterprises (developer documentation & internal wiki Q&A).
